title: Cross-domain defined-state -> interface-equivalence -> bacterial-cellulose causal gate
purpose: Test whether distinct biological-state-derived defined inputs converge on a common measured interface/microenvironment state that predicts bacterial-cellulose phenotype better than the source label itself.
claim_boundary: This artifact preregisters a causal discrimination test. It does not establish that PvLEA4, lactoferrin, placental state, maternal milk, infant sex, or any extremophile changes bacterial cellulose.

scientific_anchors.finding: Human lactoferrin can coadsorb into a phospholipid monolayer at the air/water interface and measurably alter surface pressure.
Milk-fat-globule membrane is a protein/lipid colloidal interface with phospholipids, glycoproteins and other amphiphilic constituents.
A non-nutritional silicone-polyether surfactant changed bacterial-cellulose synthesis; medium surface tension significantly affected BC yield and water-holding capacity.
Komagataeibacter normally forms BC at the air-liquid interface because oxygen is required; photosynthetic oxygen-generating partners can shift BC growth into the bulk.
Komagataeibacter can form cellulosic biofilms at oil-water as well as air-water interfaces, with lower oxygen supply associated with lower yield and different mechanical properties.

competing_hypotheses.H1_SHARED_INTERFACE_MEDIATOR: Distinct defined inputs produce equivalent BC phenotypes when the relevant interface/microenvironment mediator vector is matched.
competing_hypotheses.H2_SOURCE_SPECIFIC_RESIDUAL: A reproducible BC difference remains after mediator matching, implying an unmeasured or source-specific mechanism rather than source-label causality by itself.
competing_hypotheses.H3_GENERIC_PROTEIN_OR_LIPID_EFFECT: Apparent lactoferrin or PvLEA4 specificity collapses to total protein load, phospholipid load, osmolarity, carbon, pH or other generic medium effects.
competing_hypotheses.H4_INTERFACE_PERTURBATION_INSUFFICIENT: The inputs measurably alter interface state but BC phenotype does not change reproducibly.
competing_hypotheses.H5_MEDIATOR_VECTOR_INCOMPLETE: BC changes reproducibly without the preregistered mediator vector explaining or matching the response.

portable_mediator_vector.rule: Source identity is intentionally not matched; generic physicochemical load is matched or measured so source-specific residuals can be tested rather than assumed.

stage_A_abiotic_calibration.goal: Find preregistered interface-state match points among distinct defined input families before any bacterial-cellulose outcome is available.
stage_A_abiotic_calibration.dose_lock_rule: Candidate levels are selected only from Stage-A mediator measurements, solubility/stability constraints and reagent feasibility. All selected levels are frozen before Stage-B BC outcomes are inspected.
stage_A_abiotic_calibration.pair_match_tolerance_rule: Numerical tolerances must be fixed from instrument repeatability, technical replicates or an independent calibration set before Stage-B outcomes. Outcome-driven widening of tolerances is forbidden.
stage_A_abiotic_calibration.failure_rule: If no cross-family mediator match can be achieved within preregistered tolerance, the interface-equivalence comparison is not interpretable and no source-label conclusion is allowed.

stage_B_locked_BC_challenge.bc_producer: same frozen Komagataeibacter/BC-producing system across all arms
stage_B_locked_BC_challenge.primary_material_endpoint: dry_BC_mass under one frozen matched-batch harvest rule

equivalence_logic.required: A BC-equivalence claim requires a preregistered equivalence margin and confidence interval or equivalent bounded criterion; p > 0.05 alone is not evidence of equivalence.
equivalence_logic.equivalence_margin_rule: The BC equivalence margin must be frozen before treatment outcomes using historical batch variability, an independent pilot, or an engineering minimum-difference-of-interest rationale. It may not be estimated from the same blinded treatment outcomes being judged.
equivalence_logic.source_residual_rule: Source-specific residual analysis is allowed only after the mediator-match criterion passes.

decision_rules.if: mediator-matched distinct inputs produce BC outcomes inside the preregistered equivalence bound across independent batches
mediator match passes but a reproducible BC difference remains outside the equivalence bound
generic protein reproduces the candidate protein effect
the non-nutritional surface-tension reference phenocopies the candidate result after mediator matching
interface state shifts reproducibly but BC phenotype does not

kill_rules: No empirical BC promotion from source labels alone.
MOTHER_OF_SON and XY_PLACENTA are provenance/covariate labels, not treatment identities in this defined-component test.
No lactoferrin specificity if generic protein explains the result.
No lactoferrin-plus-lipid specificity if DPPC alone explains the result.
No shared-interface conclusion if pair matching fails.
No equivalence conclusion from non-significant difference testing alone.
No direct protein-cellulose binding claim without a direct binding/surface assay.
No material-memory claim from a terminal bulk phenotype alone.

human_material_boundary.note: This stage deliberately avoids donor human milk and placental material. Any later human-derived-material work remains institution-only under consent, ethics, biosafety, handling and disposal procedures.

material_memory_future_gate.required_future_logic: A transient, time-bounded mediator exposure must leave a spatially localizable persistent BC layer difference after the signal is removed or changed; bulk endpoint differences alone are insufficient.

promotion_logic.P1: reproducible defined-input BC effect with early mediator measurements
promotion_logic.P2: mediator-matched equivalence or reproducible source residual discriminated with generic controls
promotion_logic.P3: defined causal mediator or defined source-specific factor reproduced independently
promotion_logic.P4: transient-state spatial record / material-memory gate passed

next_gate: RUN_STAGE_A_ABIOTIC_INTERFACE_CALIBRATION; LOCK MATCHED LEVELS AND TOLERANCES BEFORE ANY STAGE_B BC OUTCOME; THEN RUN THE FROZEN TEN_ARM DEFINED_COMPONENT MATRIX.
